about: Ideal body weight by the four formulas with the arithmetic of calculateIdealWeight() and displayIdealWeightResults() in assets/js/calculator.js; our calculation for /ideal-weight/ (CMB-028). Built by research/ideal-weight-build/iw_stats.py.

rules.printed: whole lb = Math.round(lb + 1e-9); kg = Math.round(kg * 10 + 1e-9) / 10 (halves up)
rules.span: lowest to highest of the four as printed
rules.healthy: weightBounds(inches, 18.5, 24.9): whole lb and whole kg, each unit on its own
